video.title: AI欧腐《与继兄同床/I ended up in my stepbrother's bed》
video.desc:
After his father's death, Theo enters the royal palace, becoming "brothers" with cynical crown prince Wayne. Hostility turns into mutual refuge amid court intrigue. When Lucian's scheme drugs Wayne, Theo risks everything to save him; the two are torn at the brink of the forbidden. Wayne changes for love, Theo confronts his heart; together they shatter convention for their happily ever after.
父亲去世后，Theo 进入王宫，与玩世不恭的太子 Wayne 成了名义上的"兄弟"。宫廷权谋之中，两人从针锋相对，渐渐成了彼此的庇护所。
当 Lucian 设局给 Wayne 下药，Theo 不惜一切将他救下——两人也被推到了禁忌的边缘。Wayne 为爱改变，Theo 直面本心，他们携手打破世俗成见，走向属于自己的幸福结局。
